verdict.rationale: Maritime documents automatic idle shutdown: web apps and agents are put to sleep when idle and woken on demand. There is no evidence of a developer-configurable timeout, and billing is a flat subscription rather than usage-metered, so sleeping does not stop charges. missing for 10: developer-settable idle/max-lifetime timeout controls, explicit shutdown-on-completion behavior, billing that stops when idle (billing is flat), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set timeouts so sandboxes shut down automatically and stop billing when idle or done

citations.quote: Maritime builds it, runs it serverlessly, puts it to sleep when idle, and wakes it on the next visit.
three endpoints get you sleep/wake, channels, and triggers.
No meters, no hourly rates: how much your agents run never changes the bill.
